narrative_purpose: Establish isolation, danger, and the dominance of nature before any human presence appears.

setting.environment: Open sea, violent weather, towering waves, exposed rock

actions: Waves crash violently against jagged rocks below the lighthouse.
The lighthouse stands rigid and small against the scale of the sea.

camera_intent.movement: Slow, restrained push-in from wide to slightly closer wide
camera_intent.framing: Lighthouse kept small in frame, environment dominating

visual_motifs: Vertical lighthouse versus horizontal chaos of sea
constraints: Nature must visually overpower all man-made elements

narrative_purpose: Introduce the lighthouse beam as a fragile attempt at order amid chaos.
actions: The lighthouse beam sweeps slowly through sheets of rain.
Rain partially obscures the light, breaking it into fragments.

camera_intent.movement: Light provides motion, camera remains still

constraints: Lighting must feel motivated and realistic
